blocks.label: P: Built around the individual student
P: Some students come because science has become confusing and they need help findi
blocks.text: Some students come because science has become confusing and they need help finding their footing. Others are doing well but want to push further, prepare for demanding exams or work towards competitive university goals. Wherever the starting point, the first job is to work out what the student actually understands, where things are breaking down and what will make the biggest difference next.

blocks.label: P: That might mean repairing a gap that has been causing problems fo
blocks.text: That might mean repairing a gap that has been causing problems for months. It might mean learning how to turn good subject knowledge into a precise exam answer, or developing the confidence to tackle an unfamiliar problem without immediately looking for help. I keep expectations high, but I do not expect every student to reach them by exactly the same route.

blocks.label: P: The curriculum tells us where the student needs to get to; the student helps det
blocks.text: The curriculum tells us where the student needs to get to; the student helps determine how we get there. Sessions focus on understanding the science well enough to explain it, connect it and use it. Over time, I want students to recognise their own gaps, ask better questions and make more decisions about how to move forward. Good tutoring should make the student stronger and the tutor less necessary.

blocks.label: H2: Tutoring starts with a conversation rather than a commitment.
blocks.text: Tutoring starts with a conversation rather than a commitment.

blocks.label: P: Tell me what the student is studying, what is happening and where
blocks.text: Tell me what the student is studying, what is happening and where you think support would help. I arrange a phone conversation with the parent and, if it sounds as though I may be able to help, a free Meet & Greet with the student and parent together. It usually lasts about 20 minutes and gives everyone a chance to ask questions and get a sense of how I work.

blocks.label: P: There is no pressure to decide during the Meet & Greet. Take some time to think
blocks.text: There is no pressure to decide during the Meet & Greet. Take time to think about it, and message me if you’d like to move forward. I then arrange the first lesson, and we begin with the student’s immediate priorities. The plan becomes more specific as I get to know the student. The private Auxesis Portal keeps lesson information and resources organised between lessons. Access is provided by Auxesis after tutoring is confirmed.

blocks.label: P: I’m Amanda D’Souza, a science teacher and tutor with more than 25 years of exper
blocks.text: I’m Amanda D’Souza, a science teacher and tutor with more than 25 years of experience in Canada and international schools. I am an Ontario Certified Teacher, hold Qualified Teacher Status in England, and have worked as an IB Biology Assistant Examiner since 2013, with experience assessing HL Paper 2 and Internal Assessments against IB criteria. I bring that experience to tutoring, but the relationship is still personal: I want to know the learner, not just the course they are taking.
